jobs.occupation: Early Childhood Educator at Kindergarten (Erzieher/in)
jobs.description:
Phorms Education currently runs five bilingual, German-English nurseries within Heilbronn and the surrounding area as part of a cooperation with the Schwarz Group. Another daycare center will open in Bad Friedrichshall at the beginning of 2026. We care for children between the ages of 0 and 6 years in an open and partially immersive concept. Our facilities offer well-equipped functional rooms and outdoor play areas. The pedagogical focus is on bilingualism, music and STEM - the children always remain at the centre of our needs-oriented work and are involved in the day-to-day life of the nursery.

The company nurseries are part of the Phorms Education SE network of bilingual schools and nurseries, that has been enriching the educational landscape in Germany since 2006.

For our nurseries in Heilbronn/Erlenbach/Weinsberg/Bad Friedrichshall we are looking for a motivated and qualified

Early Childhood Educator

(in part-time or full-time)

Our Benefits

- An attractive salary with additional benefits (e.g. company pension scheme, monthly public transport ticket and free, freshly prepared lunch that changes daily)
- A relocation allowance and all paperwork completed and prepared for residency and work permits
- Continuing professional development opportunities
- Open concept with individual support for each child
- Innovative educational concepts and state of the art educational resources
- Short-term provision of employee housing at current market prices for a relaxed arrival

Your Responsibilities  

- Holistic support of our children in the cognitive, emotional, and creative areas
- Preparation and follow-up as well as implementation of parent meetings
- Regular observation of the holistic development and abilities of kindergarten children

Your Profile

- Certified training as an early childhood educator, a degree in education or comparable education that enables you to work as a specialist or supplementary staff member by the respective local authorities
- Identify with our pedagogical concept and are motivated to creatively implement it collaboratively as a team
- Motivated to co-create new pedagogical methodologies to continuously develop with the organisation
- Interest in working in a bilingual and international atmosphere
- Motivated and committed to working as part of a team
- Fluent English skills and German language skills at least level B2

Interested in re-shaping education? Bring your new ideas to life with us and apply now via our website (https://www.phorms.de/en/career/jobs/job/early-childhood-educator/?utm_source=afa&utm_medium=jobanzweb&utm_campaign=BaW%C3%BC_KiTa_Early_Childhood_Educator_engl_0521) .

Please visit jobs.phorms.de (https://www.phorms.de/en/career/overview/)  for more details and do not hesitate to contact Carolin and Lisa, via careers@phorms.de (https://mailto:careers@phorms.de) .

We look forward to your application!

- A high degree of freedom in the execution of your projects

With bold ideas based on our passion for innovative e-mobility solutions, we are already establishing future technologies today.

jobs.occupation: Business Development Manager – Humanoid Robotics (m/f/d) (Business-Development-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FORSynapticon builds the motion control and actuator technology at the core of next-generation humanoid robots. Our ACTILINK actuator series and Positron Safety AI architecture are deployed in some of the most demanding humanoid and advanced robotics programmes globally.

As a passionate Business Development Manager you help to drive our growth in one of the most exciting and fastest-evolving technology markets. In this role, you will build strategic customer relationships, develop new business opportunities, and position our solutions within the global humanoid robotics ecosystem. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, and executive leadership to expand our market presence and accelerate the adoption of our technology.

If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy building markets from the ground up, and are excited about Physical AI and robotics, we'd love to hear from you.
HERE'S WHERE YOU MAKE AN IMPACT
• Build, develop, and successfully convert a strong sales pipeline within the humanoid robotics market.
• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with OEMs, robotics companies, technology providers, and research institutions.
• Drive initiatives that increase brand awareness and generate high-quality leads within the Physical AI ecosystem.
• Establish and grow long-term strategic partnerships and alliances with leading industry, technology, and research organizations worldwide.
• Represent the company at international trade fairs, conferences, and industry events to strengthen our market presence and network.
• Work closely with Marketing to develop campaigns and initiatives that accelerate customer acquisition and conversion.
• Develop account-specific growth strategies for strategic customers and key opportunities.
• Continuously analyze global market developments, customer needs, and competitive activities in AI, robotics, and automation.
• Act as the voice of the humanoid robotics market internally by contributing to the product roadmap and identifying future customer requirements.
• Collaborate across departments to continuously improve the customer experience for humanoid robotics application.

WHO YOU ARE
• Several years of experience in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Strategic Account Management within robotics, automation, industrial technology, AI, or related high-tech industries.
• Strong understanding of the humanoid robotics landscape or a genuine passion to become an expert in this emerging field.
• Proven ability to develop new markets, build strategic partnerships, and close complex B2B opportunities.
• Experience working with international customers and cross-functional teams.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a hands-on attitude and a strong sense of ownership.
• Willingness to travel extensively internationally to meet customers, partners, attend industry events, and support business development activities worldwide.
• First experience in public speaking with the interest and enthusiasm to represent the company at international conferences, trade shows, panel discussions.
• Fluent English skills; additional languages are a plus.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU
• A warm, international team that truly enjoys working together
• Plenty of creative freedom and the opportunity to make a real impact
• Flexible working hours and hybrid work options
• Short decision-making paths, flat hierarchies, and open communication
• Professional development opportunities and exciting projects
• 30 days of paid vacation
• Full-time position (40 hours/week) with a permanent contract
• Company pension scheme through Dyno
• Flexible working hours when life takes unexpected turns
• Company-supported gym memberships through Wellpass
• A company-sponsored health program (WLP app, regular physical activities, nutritional coaching, and more)
• Job bike program to support a healthy commute (optional)
• Birthday vouchers
• Snacks and fresh fruit for all employees, plus breakfast every Monday
• Free drinks and coffee, of course
• Regular global team-building events such as bootcamps, ski trips, and summer BBQs — spouses and children are warmly invited to Friday BBQ events
• Modern office spaces

About us HACKING THE PHYSICS AND ECONOMICS OF MOTION CONTROL WITH DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY

At Synapticon, we are revolutionizing motion control for robotics and machines—right at the point of motion.
Our approach is completely new: we integrate previously separate components such as motors, drives, sensors, and gearboxes into seamless units. At the same time, we are digitizing performance and quality factors that previously depended on expensive mechanical manufacturing.
World-leading innovators are choosing Synapticon to pave their way into the future of intelligent, motion-controlled systems.

Be part of our success story – apply now at Synapticon!
